name: United States Code
description: Federal statutory law across successive editions. The collection combines web text, historical OCR, and derived structured representations.
coverage: Web: 1994–2023, with partial 2024 material. A separate OCR + LLM collection covers 13 editions from 1926–2000.
quality: Text quality and completeness have not yet been validated for this project. Historical web editions include known gaps.

sources.label: Office of the Law Revision Counsel

name: Code of Federal Regulations
description: Federal administrative regulations, connecting annual web editions, historical page-level OCR, and derived tables for longitudinal analysis.
coverage: Web: 1996–2025, with partial 2026 material. OCR archive folders: 1938 and 1940–2025; coverage is not a completeness guarantee.
quality: Early web editions have missing titles. OCR accuracy and coverage have not yet been validated for this project.

name: Wikipedia rules
description: A reference study on Wikipedia rules. A raw corpus has not yet been confirmed in the project collection.

name: The legal profession
description: Reference material on the Korean legal profession. Comparable time series for other countries are not yet confirmed.

name: Managerial intensity
description: Existing analysis figures, code, presentation materials, and references for studying organizational structure.

name: Case law
description: A planned comparative collection. No case-law corpus is currently recorded in the project inventory.

name: Legal services industry
description: A prospective collection for research on legal services. Data collection has not yet been recorded.
